main.description: Deprecated, and no longer served. Added this appview's DID to the private repository's appviews, or takes it out, in the repository record its owner keeps in its space, with the session the appview keeps for the owner logged in to its pages. Let, the appview syncs the repository's space into an index of its own, apart from its public one, with the session of a member who reads it there, and shows it from that only to members proven so. Taken back, it forgets that index at once. A public repository every appview indexes. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.
